title: From a Nepal in Pain, a Young Leader Makes a Case for Climate Reparations
summary: Balendra Shah, 36, comes to the U.N. as a sun-glassed symbol of Gen Z political power. But concerns about his style are growing at home after devastating floods left thousands dead or missing.
